title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 330 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

The Sun is about halfway through its roughly 10-billion-year main-sequence lifetime. Still plenty of time before retirement. 🌞☀️

A broad coronal-hole-like region is the main feature in today’s solar images, while sunspot activity remains low.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
